recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x same middle/base lower initiator), against the checked-in board surface. Construction through the first divergent lower-card single is inherited from a digest-pinned dependency; keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed. The application module is stubbed, and only the immediate same-lower logical-index-1/2 whole-group single=false rotation is retained as the measured transition.

included: forty-eight independently constructed marker-free histories, executed as separate ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case captures

local/opponent active and sole-bench histories beginning from an unrefreshed clean top-driven group q1/q2/q3 state, followed by exactly one middle/base single=true reset and an immediate whole-group single=false rotation initiated by that same lower card

exact pre-state inheritance from the matching compound-lower-nonzero-group-single-v1 post-state, including turns, BREAK flags, margins, stack/card rectangles, ten hit probes, and the full operation-trace prefix
the measured lower-card whole-group branch advancing every Pokemon one quarter-turn while preserving all per-card BREAK flags, including the q0-to-q1 lower initiator remaining false

the successor collision with the corresponding top-initiated checkpoint: identical turns and flags everywhere, exact active geometry, exact bench geometry when margins agree, and a signed -0.015625 px frame-local bench translation when lower- versus top-initiator margins differ
digest-pinned active/bench plain-R ingress and clicked-lower-to-zone/logical-index-1-or-2 selection, without executing the application keydown listener

exact measured-transition trace and payload, initiator-dependent inline margins, logical-versus-DOM selection, topology and links, painted/authored rectangles, physical-frame mappings, ten native hit probes and orders, stable identifiers, observer ownership, and cleanup
excluded: a different lower card or the top card initiating the measured whole-group rotation
a second single-card transition, repeated measured group rotation, or refresh/movement between the divergent single and measured group action
pristine q0, returned/history-authored q0, alternate imported/refreshed/replayed/restored/moved pre-state histories, and mixed initiators
refresh, movement, promotion, evolution/removal, leaveAll, undo, replay, or wrapper reconstruction after the first divergent lower-card transition
normalizing per-evolution turns, BREAK flags, or wrapper-margin history into canonical v2 state, commands, rendering, or UX
converted categories, non-Pokemon initiators, Energy, Trainer, Tool, markers/counters, attachments, mixed dimensions, and noncanonical assets
additional bench siblings, flex shrink, overflow, resize-driven layout, explicit flip, fullscreen, alternate viewport/DPR, and concealment
application/network opponent forwarding, candidate parity, and production/domain/protocol/schema/UI behavior

phaseEvidenceTupleSchema: hit points in expected.hitRegionOrder, each [x,y] or null

provenanceClaims.claim: Plain-R keyboard ingress requests whole-group rotation for the selected lower card and forwards its logical index.
Lower/index-1-or-2 single=false turn mutation, sibling rotation, unchanged per-card BREAK flags, lower-initiator-turn-dependent margins, and action payload used by this capture.
Clicked lower-card ingress resolves the containing zone and the selected logical card index used by rotate-card.
